visual_synopsis: In a bare white hospital corridor a surgeon in blue scrubs and cap, mask hanging at his neck, talks back and forth with a mustached man in a black jacket over a loud floral shirt, the whole sketch cut as alternating close-ups of the two. Midway a young woman in a black top and white jeans appears in the doorway holding a sheet of paper, shows it to them and leaves, and the two men keep talking to the end.
